visual_elements.description: Neural-network schematic inside a beige rounded rectangle. Three horizontal rows (one per class). Each row, left to right: (1) small filled magenta dot (input) with thin gray fan-in lines; (2) white circle with black outline containing bold 'Σ S' [? second glyph resembles an S / sigmoid-step symbol]; (3) three small gray outline circles in a row (ellipsis meaning 'more neurons'); (4) second white 'Σ S' circle with red italic bold label 'O_i' at its upper right; (5) light-green circle with black outline containing 'Σ S' with red italic bold label 'O_j' at its upper right. The three O_i neurons are fully connected to the three O_j neurons by 9 crossing red arrows with red triangular arrowheads; blue italic bold 'w_ji' labels sit on the three roughly-horizontal arrows (one per row). Red arrows also leave each green neuron toward its Output box. Above the panel, red italic bold 'Net_i' (over the O_i column) and 'Net_j' (over the O_j column), each with a small pointer angling down toward its column.

'Input Samples' box: small pink/magenta rectangle, thin dark border, black bold text on two lines ('Input' / 'Samples'). A dotted magenta line exits its right edge, runs horizontally across the top of the diagram, and terminates in a right-pointing arrowhead at the 'Sample Label' box.
'Sample Label' box: small pink/magenta rectangle matching 'Input Samples', black bold text on two lines ('Sample' / 'Label'), receiving the dotted magenta arrow.
Three white output boxes with thin black borders, black bold text: 'Output 1' (top row), 'Output 2' (middle row), 'Output m' (bottom row). Each receives a red arrow from the green neuron of its row.
visual_elements.position: right of network panel, ~52-59% width, three rows

visual_elements.description: Vertical 'Error' bar: tall narrow dark-red rectangle; the word 'Error' in white bold sans-serif is stacked vertically three times (one per output row), reading 'Error / Error / Error' top to bottom.
Three light-green class boxes with thin black borders, black bold text: 'Class 1', 'Class 2', 'Class m', each aligned with one Output/Error row.

Two upward-pointing block arrows below the panel: left arrow is white with black outline and contains black bold 'i'; right arrow is light green and contains black bold 'j'. Each points up into the network panel, indicating the previous layer (i) and current layer (j).
'Previous Layer Layer (i)' box: lavender/light-blue rectangle, thin dark border, black bold text on two lines: 'Previous Layer' / 'Layer (i)'. Sits directly under the white 'i' arrow.
'Current Layer (You are here)' box: light-green rectangle, thin dark border, black bold text on two lines: 'Current Layer' / '(You are here)'. Sits directly under the green 'j' arrow.

Three cream equation boxes with thin black borders, each containing one formula in italic serif math with true subscripts/superscripts: (1) 'Net_j = Σ ( w_ji O_i )'; (2) 'O_j = f ( Net_j ) = 1/(1+e^{-Net_j})' with the last term shown as a vertical fraction; (3) 'E = (1/2) Σ_j ( t_j - O_j )²' with ½ as a fraction and a large summation sign with subscript j.
